_comment: What a move to another Home Assistant deliberately does not carry. Read by tests/test_migration_roundtrip.py AND e2e/migration/run.mjs, so the in-process test and the two-instance run judge by the same rules.

runtime_only_state.next_history_ref: re-derived from the highest history number at the next completion
runtime_only_state.trigger_cleared_at: seeds a post-completion cooldown of minutes after a restart
runtime_only_state.todo_mirror: item ids in this instance's to-do lists; the mirror re-links on sync

expected_diffs.on_complete_action.configured_by: the action runs as the importing admin (SEC-2, bug audit 2026-09-27)

non_portable_options.admin_panel_user_ids: HA user ids of this instance
non_portable_options.shopping_list_entity: a to-do entity of this instance
non_portable_options.member_display: avatar overrides keyed by this instance's user ids
